ValidationRule.description: First Bill Date" is mandatory when thr Total Opportunity Amount >= 25KUSD and stage move to 4 or 5. Updated this VR for the story #14169 : Opportunity: Make First Bill Date mandatory for all Opps moving to Stage 5, removing the Amount Criteria.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND( NOT($Setup.Metadata_Activation_Settings__c.Disable_VR__c && OR(ISBLANK($Setup.Metadata_Activation_Settings__c.SObject_API_Name__c), CONTAINS($Setup.Metadata_Activation_Settings__c.SObject_API_Name__c, 'Opportunity'))),
OR(ISPICKVAL(StageName, "5 - Signed/PO in")), NOT(ISPICKVAL( Type , 'Renewal')),
ISBLANK( IM_Booked_Date__c),
$Profile.Name <> 'IM_Sales_IMTN',
NOT(OR($Permission.Bypass_Opportunity_Validations, $Permission.VR_Bypass_Permission)) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: First Bill Date is required for this opportunity. Need help? Contact your Sales Operations Business Partner.
